name: The name a worker credential writes under is nobody else's
summary: actor_names.collision is the one rule for a worker credential's actor namespace: its head, case folded, must not be a session actor of the project or a name of that shape, a name on the operator or verifier list, or the web service's namespace. The credential issue route asks the host through the backend's actor_standing (endpoint action actor-standing) and answers 422 before anything is kept; http_authority.descriptor_actor_denial makes the endpoint refuse at use any name without the shape of a web id that is not inside a worker credential's own, uncolliding namespace. admin.py credential-actors lists existing credentials with the rule each breaks, reading only.
